annotations.title: Count screens against the plan limit

description:
Count screens against the plan limit

Tells how many Presence screens you have (`devices`, every screen you created, paired or not) and how many your plans pay for (`deviceLimit`, `null` when there is no limit). Check it before `create_presence_device`, which fails with 403 once `devices` has reached `deviceLimit`. For plans, prices and avatar minutes use `get_presence_billing`. Read only.
name: get_presence_allowance
